00031 /**
00032  * @brief               Create a label widget
00033  *
00034  * HxLabelNew creates a new label widget.  The application is
00035  * responsible for defining the position of the label, but it can let
00036  * the toolkit compute the height and width by passing 0 for those
00037  * members of the pBounds rect structure.  If the label's string
00038  * extends beyond the bounds, it is clipped.
00039  *
00040  * The standard system font is used if pFont is NULL.
00041  *
00042  * @param id            IN:     Unique ID for the widget, defined by app,
00043  *                              or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
00044  * @param pParent       IN:     Pointer to "parent" widget containing label
00045  * @param pBounds       IN:     Pointer to the label bounding rectangle.
00046  *                              If width or height is 0, they will be
00047  *                              computed for you based on the text and
00048  *                              the font selected for the label.
00049  * @param pFont         IN:     HxFont_t pointer or NULL to use standard font.
00050  * @param pText         IN:     pointer to a string
00051  * @param hLabel        OUT:    Handle to the new label; *hLabel is
00052  *                              NULL on failure
00053  *
00054  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.  Returns
00055  *                              HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails,
00056  *                              and sets *hLabel to NULL.
00057  *
00058  **/
00059 HxResult HxLabelNew(uint32_t id, HxWidget_t* pParent,
00060                     const HxRectangle_t* pBounds, HxFont_t* pFont,
00061                     const char* pText, HxLabel_t** hLabel);
00062 
00063 /**
00064  * @brief               Delete a label widget
00065  *
00066  * HxLabelDelete deletes a label created from an earlier call to HxLabelNew.
00067  *
00068  * It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application,
00069  * since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is
00070  * deleted.  HxLabelDelete only needs to be called when deleting a label
00071  * at runtime.
00072  *
00073  * @param pLabel        IN:     Pointer to the label to delete
00074  *
00075  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.  
00076  *
00077  **/
00078 HxResult HxLabelDelete(HxLabel_t* pLabel);

00081 /**
00082  * @brief               Set the text attributes of a label
00083  *
00084  * HxLabelSetAttributes sets the text attributes of a label.  The text
00085  * attributes are a HxTextFlags_t value, defined in hxgraphics.h.  HxLabelNew
00086  * sets the label's attributes to the default value of kHxDefaultTextFlags
00087  * (left aligned, with the text origin relative to the top left corner of the
00088  * label's bounds).

00090  * @param pLabel        IN:     Pointer to the label
00091  * @param attributes    IN:     HxTextFlags_t
00092  *
00093  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.  Returns
00094  *                              HX_INVALID_ARG if attributes is invalid.
00095  *
00096  **/
00097 HxResult HxLabelSetAttributes(HxLabel_t* pLabel, HxTextFlags_t attributes);
